features.title: Operations review
features.description: Administrator-only bounded operations advice. Do not include identifiable patient information. This provider response does not register a model release, evaluate a clinical model, record a patient draft, or approve care.

fields.label: Prompt
presets: Summarize which operational evidence the care team should review before its weekly coordination meeting; flag gaps and route clinical decisions to licensed clinicians.
Compare practical options for tracking unresolved trial eligibility questions and identify what the research coordinator should verify with the study team.
Outline how to audit caregiver follow-up workflow for missed handoffs, while keeping all patient-level decisions with the clinical team.

fields.label: Goal
presets: Prepare a concise coordination brief for the weekly care team meeting.
Create a decision support checklist for trial referral operations.
Identify process improvements for caregiver communication follow-up.

fields.label: Context
presets: A multidisciplinary team is reviewing visit follow-up, caregiver communication, and trial referral workflow without patient identifiers.
The referral team has incomplete source documentation and needs a repeatable review process; no individual eligibility decision is requested.
Operations staff want to review handoff timing, task ownership, and escalation paths at a process level.

fields.label: Audience
presets: Care coordinators and a supervising clinician.
Research coordinators and the principal investigator.
Care operations lead and clinical supervisor.

fields.label: Source summary
presets: Use only the non-identifiable workflow facts entered here; identify any source that needs verification.
Treat protocol criteria and site availability as unverified until checked against current study materials.
Use workflow descriptions supplied in this prompt; list records to inspect rather than assuming their contents.

fields.label: Constraints
presets: Do not diagnose, prescribe, enroll anyone, or recommend a care change; mark uncertainty and require clinician review.
Do not infer eligibility or promise enrollment; cite verification steps and escalation owners.
No patient identifiers, diagnosis, treatment advice, or autonomous outreach.

fields.label: Budget
presets: Existing staff time only; no new spend is authorized.
Use existing research coordination capacity.
No additional tools or paid services assumed.

fields.label: Deadline
presets: Before the next weekly coordination meeting.
Ahead of the next referral review.
For the monthly operations review.

fields.label: Tone
presets: Clear, cautious, and operational.
Neutral and precise.
Practical and respectful.

fields.label: Output format
presets: Sections for known facts, missing evidence, proposed checks, owners, and uncertainty.
Comparison table with option, evidence needed, owner, risk, and next step.
Short executive summary followed by a handoff checklist and an uncertainty section.
